**Apple's FY2024 gross margin: $180,683 million**

- Fiscal year 2024 ended September 28, 2024: total net sales of $391,035 million less cost of sales of $210,352 million yields a gross margin of $180,683 million [DOC-1]. That equates to a gross margin rate of approximately 46.2% of net sales (180,683 ÷ 391,035).

Comparability note: The figure above is a single-period, as-reported amount drawn directly from Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K [DOC-1], so no cross-entity or cross-basis adjustment is needed. If you intend to compare it to the prior-year gross margin of $169,148 million on net sales of $383,285 million [DOC-1], note that the two fiscal years end on different dates (September 28, 2024 vs. September 30, 2023) [DOC-1], and Apple's 52/53-week fiscal calendar means the periods may not cover an identical number of weeks — a modest caveat for any growth-rate calculation.

ANSWER: $180,683 million (approximately 46.2% of net sales)
